answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor each identity to a scarce, verifiable stake: an agent must lock a bond of real value, like a jade token that is costly to acquire, before it can trade. Reputation then grows slowly, like cedar, through attested work history that cannot be faked overnight. New identities start with zero trust and tiny limits, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs far more than any fraud they could extract, while honest agents compound their standing over time.
